description: Removed 26 Sep 2026 — TikTok deleted the public Creative Center song chart in its TikTok One migration. Calls answer 410 Gone at 0 credits; the endpoint returns if TikTok restores the chart. Costs 2 credits. Empty results and failures are never charged. Pass cache=true for a free 24h cache hit (default always fresh).

cache.description: Set true to serve from the 24h response cache (0 credits on hit). Default false — always fetch fresh.

limit.description: Max items to return (default 20, max 20). Flat 2 credits per call.

newOnBoard.description: Only sounds newly on the Top 100.

page.description: Creative Center page (1–20). Echoed on a native chart 200 with hasMore. Omitted on the extended path — that list is one page.

name: tiktok_popular_songs
